contributions.claim: Trump announces an immediate Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire and claims both sides agreed; Zelenskyy says the deal is news to him.
contributions.attribution: Trump's social post and Zelenskyy via Guardian
contributions.uncertainty: Announcement and agreement claim do not establish a mutually operative ceasefire.

contributions.claim: Zelenskyy reportedly signals acceptance if Moscow does, says Ukraine supports de-escalation and is awaiting US details; von der Leyen expresses support.
contributions.attribution: Zelenskyy and von der Leyen via Guardian
contributions.uncertainty: Conditional support is not unqualified bilateral agreement.

delta_expectations.reason: Announcement, surprise reaction and conditional response all materially define initial state.

questions.claim: Whether Russia accepts and what ceasefire terms apply remain unclear despite Trump's claim.

ambiguity_notes: Two reports captured together show different reactions without proving a source correction or separate ceasefire occurrence.
